programs_provider.name: programs_provider
programs_provider.value:
("programs"."provider_type" = 'university' and "programs"."university_id" is not null and "programs"."college_id" is null)
        or ("programs"."provider_type" = 'college' and "programs"."college_id" is not null and "programs"."university_id" is null)

programs_pre_year_required.name: programs_pre_year_required
programs_pre_year_required.value:
("programs"."level" = 'bachelor' and "programs"."pre_year_required" is not null and "programs"."pre_year_required" in ('yes', 'no', 'unknown'))
        or ("programs"."level" <> 'bachelor' and "programs"."pre_year_required" is null)

share_links_item.name: share_links_item
share_links_item.value: ("share_links"."scope" = 'item' and "share_links"."item_id" is not null) or ("share_links"."scope" = 'tracker' and "share_links"."item_id" is null)

tracker_items_target.name: tracker_items_target
tracker_items_target.value: "tracker_items"."program_id" is not null or "tracker_items"."pathway_id" is not null or "tracker_items"."scholarship_id" is not null

user_badges_university.name: user_badges_university
user_badges_university.value: ("user_badges"."type" = 'studies_here' and "user_badges"."university_id" is not null) or ("user_badges"."type" = 'team' and "user_badges"."university_id" is null)
